newsitem.title: USA: Mossimo sees no reason for stock activity.
newsitem.headline: Mossimo sees no reason for stock activity.

text.p: Mossimo Inc said Thursday it is not aware of any "material developments" at the company that would explain trading in its shares today.
Mossimo's shares were off 2-1/2 to 23-7/8 by mid-afternoon on volume of about 491,000 shares. The statement responds to to an inquiry from the New York Stock Exchange, Mossimo said.

The maker of men's and women's activewear and sportswear went public in February in a highly-anticipated offer that saw its shares jump to 25 from an opening at 18. The stock traded as high as 49-1/8 in mid-September before slumping on a projected third quarter earnings shortfall.
